answers.reason: The chancellor is responsible for the budget and administration, and members only take part in the single place where their specific matters are decided.
The chancellor is responsible for the university's budget, which is the specific matter decided in the budget planning round.
The chancellor deals with the budget and central administration, not faculty professorship appointments.
The chancellor heads the central administration and does not sit in bodies dealing with faculty-level affairs.
The chancellor is responsible for the budget and staff, not for preparing changes to degree programmes.
The chancellor has no role in deciding individual student examination matters.
The chancellor manages the central budget, whereas this round awards faculty-level internal research grants.
The chancellor does not deal with rewriting module descriptions for degree programmes.
The chancellor sets the central budget frame rather than choosing specific equipment within a fixed laboratory budget.
The chancellor is responsible for the budget and staff, not planning the orientation week for new students.
